method.mechanical_pass: scripts/contract_authority_audit.py enumerates every scalar leaf of each contract and greps src/ modal_apps/ tools/ scripts/ for the leaf KEY NAME. diagnostics/ is excluded because it holds frozen source capsules (copies), where a hit is not a live consumption.
method.human_pass: Every mentioned key was then read at its consumption site to separate OPERATIVE from RECEIPT-ONLY.
method.soundness: MEASURED. The 'never mentioned' set is SOUND: a key absent from every runtime module cannot be read by name.
method.incompleteness: MEASURED. It is NOT complete, in two directions. (1) FALSE DEAD POSITIVES for map-valued fields whose KEYS are file paths: runtime_inputs_sha256.* and implementation_sha256.* were flagged 'never mentioned' because the script keys on the leaf name (a path), while the PARENT field is operative (t4_integrated_route_fiber_parp1_app.py:106-109; pmo_population_v1.py:128-129). A per-field check must treat a path-keyed map as ONE field. (2) FALSE NEGATIVES: a key that is mentioned may still be receipt-only; claim_boundary is the worst case, mentioned twice and operative zero times.

classification_vocabulary.OPERATIVE: read at runtime and changes behaviour
classification_vocabulary.GUARD-ONLY: read, but only compared against a hardcoded constant; cannot be varied without editing code
classification_vocabulary.DERIVED: computed from other fields; derivation verified
classification_vocabulary.RECEIPT-ONLY: read, but only copied into an output artifact. NOT operative.
classification_vocabulary.PROSE-ONLY: human-readable narrative, never read. Acceptable if distinguishable.
classification_vocabulary.DEAD: declared, looks scientific, nothing reads it. The dangerous class.

T4_nodistill_shared_controller.verdict: HEALTHIEST LANE AUDITED - and it is the counterexample that proves the T4-250 findings are defects, not intent
T4_nodistill_shared_controller.measured: The runtime reads the SCORED contract, not the preparation config (variant selection at modal_apps/t4_shared_controller_completion_v1_app.py:22-31, FINAL_CONTRACT_PATH at :127). It passes the controller block WHOLESALE as controller_config=checkpoint_controller_config(contract) (:820, :1129-1138) instead of as hand-listed kwargs, and src/compose_v4/experiments/t4_shared_controller_checkpoint.py:122-134 enforces a REQUIRED set {parents, parent_explore, batch, exploration, expert_floor_rounds, route_scale_floor_rounds, value_penalty} with `missing -> ValueError`, then range-validates each (:135-152) and forwards route_scale_floor_rounds at :625 and scale_floor_scope at :163-165. It also reads the operational timing fields the held lane drops: settings['query_wait_seconds'] (:859,:1137), settings['proposal_wait_seconds'] (:962), settings['driver_poll_seconds'] (:886,:1043,:1180), and settings['scale_balanced'] (:411).
T4_nodistill_shared_controller.consequence: Same contract vocabulary, two runtimes, opposite outcomes. The held-target app enumerates kwargs one at a time and silently drops two; the shared-controller app passes a mapping through a fail-closed normalizer. The per-kwarg style IS the defect generator, and the required-set normalizer is the in-repo precedent for the CI check proposed below.

proposed_ci_check.status: PROPOSED ONLY - deliberately NOT wired into prelaunch_gate.py or any existing gate, per the audit brief.
proposed_ci_check.name: scripts/check_contract_authority.py (not yet written)
proposed_ci_check.principle: Every contract field must be in exactly one declared authority class, and the class must be provable from code. The check does not guess which fields are scientific; the contract declares it, and the check proves the declaration.

step_1_registry.what: Each audited contract gains a sibling file configs/authority/<contract-stem>.authority.json mapping every leaf path to one of OPERATIVE | GUARD | DERIVED | RECEIPT | PROSE | ACKNOWLEDGED_DEAD.
step_1_registry.why: The registry, not the check, carries the judgement. ACKNOWLEDGED_DEAD requires a one-line reason, so a dead field becomes a visible, reviewable decision instead of an accident.
step_1_registry.bootstrap: diagnostics/contract_authority_audit_v1.json (this file) is the seed content for the first registries.

step_2_completeness.what: Enumerate the contract's leaf paths (scripts/contract_authority_audit.py leaf_paths(), already written) and fail if any leaf is absent from the registry or any registry entry names a leaf that no longer exists.
step_2_completeness.catches: A new field added to a contract with no authority decision - the entry point for every instance in this audit.
step_2_completeness.note: Treat a map whose keys are repo-relative paths (runtime_inputs_sha256, implementation_sha256, material_code_sha256) as ONE leaf keyed by the parent name. This is the false-DEAD-positive class the mechanical pass hit.

step_3_operative_proof.what: For each OPERATIVE leaf, require at least one runtime reference under src/ modal_apps/ tools/ scripts/ (diagnostics/ excluded) of the form contract["<leaf>"], contract.get("<leaf>"), payload["<leaf>"], <var>["<leaf>"] or a kwarg <leaf>=. Fail with the leaf name if there are zero.
step_3_operative_proof.catches: scale_balanced, route_scale_floor_rounds, legacy_resume, controller.calls_per_task, budget.max_rounds, runtime.*, round_lock_policy.*, base.small_ring_*, prohibitions.*, metrics.*, outputs.result.
step_3_operative_proof.precision_note: MEASURED on this audit's data: this grep-level rule produced ~0.8 precision before human review, with all false positives in the path-keyed-map class that step 2's note removes. Recall against the five known instances was 5/5 for the combination of steps 3 and 5.

step_4_receipt_is_not_operative.what: For each OPERATIVE leaf, require at least one reference that is NOT inside a dict literal being written to an artifact. Implement by AST, not regex: parse each runtime module, find Subscript/keyword reads of the leaf, and reject a read whose enclosing expression is a Dict value that flows into a function named publish*/write*/_publish/_write_json/json.dumps.
step_4_receipt_is_not_operative.catches: claim_boundary (2 reads, both into receipts), base.checkpoint_sha256, data.ring_catalog_support_policy, task_roles.
step_4_receipt_is_not_operative.why: This is the rule the brief states and the one a plain grep cannot express.

step_5_no_shadow_constant.what: For each OPERATIVE or GUARD leaf with a numeric or boolean value, scan the runtime modules that reference the contract for a module-level assignment whose literal equals that value and whose name upper-cases to the leaf name (route_scale_floor_rounds ~ ROUTE_SCALE_FLOOR_ROUNDS, max_rounds ~ MAX_ROUNDS, queries_per_round ~ QUERIES_PER_ROUND). Report as WARN, not FAIL, naming both sites.
step_5_no_shadow_constant.catches: MAX_ROUNDS/QUERIES_PER_ROUND/INIT_COUNT vs the PMO budget block - the instance-3 shape where contract and constant agree today and drift tomorrow.
step_5_no_shadow_constant.note: WARN not FAIL because a validating duplicate is sometimes deliberate; the point is that it must be seen.

step_6_derivation.what: Each DERIVED entry carries a python expression over sibling leaves; evaluate it and fail on mismatch.
step_6_derivation.catches: charged_calls_total == charged_calls_per_task * len(tasks); candidate_calls_per_task == charged_calls_per_task - initialization_calls_per_task; exact_oracle_calls_per_start_seed_arm == 1 + replicates*(slots+1). All three MEASURED as currently holding.

step_7_prose_consistency.what: For every PROSE or RECEIPT leaf whose value is a string, extract numeric tokens and any token matching (delta|d)\s*=?\s*0\.\d+, and fail if a token contradicts the OPERATIVE leaf of the same name. Seed the name map with {delta, charged_calls_per_cell, charged_calls_per_task, calls_per_task, steps, horizon}.
step_7_prose_consistency.catches: known instances 1 and 2 directly - claim_boundary 'delta 0.6' vs delta: 0.4, and experimental_setting '49-call ceiling' vs charged_calls_per_cell: 250.
step_7_prose_consistency.caveat: INFERRED that a numeric-token rule is tractable here; MEASURED that both known prose defects carry the number as a bare token in the same string, so the seed rule does fire on both. Expect false positives on narrative numbers (e.g. '77 locked routes'), which is why the name map is an allowlist rather than 'any number'.

step_8_sibling_parity.what: Group contracts by schema_version. Within a group, fail if a leaf path is present in some members and absent in others without an explicit registry waiver.
step_8_sibling_parity.catches: META-1, the braf/parp1-vs-others shape drift across the six 250-call contracts.

proposed_ci_check.cost: INFERRED. Steps 2,3,5,6,7,8 are text/AST over ~13 contracts and ~15 runtime modules: well under a second. Step 4 needs one ast.parse per runtime module, still sub-second. No chemistry, no RDKit, no oracle, no network.
